metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Mina Lamplight
records.biography_en: Mina Lamplight joins The Insect Hotel as moth guest. “Is the lamp included?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short rounded fuzzy antenna accents and a tiny bedside lamp held in hand.

records.name: Bert Bagbeetle
records.biography_en: Bert Bagbeetle joins The Insect Hotel as beetle porter. “One bag. Very round.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two small beetle-shell shoulder plates and a smooth luggage ball on a short strap.

records.name: Tess Pollenstamp
records.biography_en: Tess Pollenstamp joins The Insect Hotel as bee at pollen customs. “Please declare the pollen.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small amber jar and oversized clean rubber stamp.

records.name: Ned Roomreed
records.biography_en: Ned Roomreed joins The Insect Hotel as reception clerk. “The middle reed is yours.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: three bundled hollow reeds with tiny blank room tags.

records.name: Hal Cocoonlaundry
records.biography_en: Hal Cocoonlaundry joins The Insect Hotel as laundry attendant. “The silk is almost dry.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny folded cocoon-shaped blanket held at waist.

records.name: Otto Leafbell
records.biography_en: Otto Leafbell joins The Insect Hotel as night porter. “Someone rang in the bark.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: little leaf-shaped call bell with brass knob.
